code:
services:
  api:
    image: northbridge/storefront-api:2.1
    environment:
      DB_HOST: db
    env_file:
      - .env
caption: environment: is fine for non-sensitive config; env_file: loads real values from a separate file.
The real values live in a local .env file that git never sees.

code:
services:
  api:
    image: northbridge/storefront-api:2.1
    secrets:
      - db_password

secrets:
  db_password:
    file: ./secrets/db_password.txt
caption: Secrets mount as files at /run/secrets/db_password instead of as environment variables.
